program.section_heading: Automotive Basics Noncredit Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Develop industry required skills for students to gain automotive service entry level jobs such as lube technicians or technician aids.
Provide courses for currently employed automotive service students to advance their skill and knowledge to be qualified for advanced placement job (journeyman).
Support the automotive industry training needs by providing certification/license training courses.

notes: Read the Noncredit Certificate of Completion section only. The page also prints the credit Skills Certificate (AUTO 0100, AUTO 0140, 7 units) under the same title, and that section was not used.
The catalog prints AUTO 0800/AUTO 0840 with a leading zero. They match closed-list AUTO 800/AUTO 840, so they are not marked as additions.

The section counts the award in units and prints 0 units per course and 'Total Units 0'. It prints no hours, so measure is 'units'. The course descriptions give 108 hours for AUTO 0800 and 110 hours for AUTO 0840; a reviewer may prefer to record the award in hours (218 total, which the catalog does not state).
The PSLOs are printed once on the department's outcomes tab and are not tied to a specific award. They are recorded here as shared by this award.
The careers are taken from the PSLO text: lube technicians, technician aids, journeyman.
